description: Use this when the user wants printable mazes (maze generator, maze puzzles, maze worksheets, circle maze, hexagon maze) as a PDF with an answer key. Put one object per maze in mazes[] when the mazes differ (shape, difficulty or size, age); for a set of the same kind, set count with shape and difficulty, or pass the child's age. Each maze has a single solution (only one path from Start to Finish, checked by a breadth-first search); the PDF has 1, 2 or 4 mazes per page on Letter or A4, an optional title and name line, and answer pages with the path drawn. Defaults: 1 medium rectangle maze, Letter, 1 per page, name line and answer key on. Does not make picture-shaped mazes, mazes with several solutions, or solve a maze from a photo.

age.description: Age of the solver; picks the difficulty when none is given (4 and under very easy, 5 to 7 easy, 8 to 10 medium, 11 and up hard). Example: 7

answer_key.description: Add answer pages with the solution path drawn (default true). Example: true

count.description: How many mazes when they are all the same kind (1 to 20, default 1). Example: 4

difficulty.description: Difficulty for all mazes: very easy, easy, medium (default), hard or expert. Example: easy

age.description: Age of the child solving it, used to pick the difficulty when none is given. Example: 7

algorithm.description: backtracker (default, long winding corridors) or wilson (more short dead ends). Example: wilson

difficulty.description: very easy, easy, medium (default), hard or expert. Sets the grid size. Example: easy

seed.description: Seed for this maze (same seed and size give the same maze). Example: 4821

shape.description: rectangle (default), circle (round theta maze, finish in the centre) or hexagon (honeycomb cells). Example: circle

size.description: Grid size instead of a difficulty: columns x rows for rectangle and hexagon ("20x25"), number of rings for circle ("10"). Example: "15x20"

mazes.description: One object per maze when the mazes differ, e.g. [{"shape":"circle","difficulty":"easy"},{"shape":"rectangle","size":"20x25"}]. Leave out and use count for a set of the same kind. Up to 20.

name_line.description: Print a Name and Date line on the maze pages (default true). Example: false

paper.description: letter (default, US 8.5 x 11 in) or a4. Example: a4

per_page.description: Mazes per printed page: 1 (default), 2 or 4. Example: 2

seed.description: Starting seed; maze N uses seed + N - 1. Reuse it to reprint the same mazes. Example: 2026

shape.description: Shape for all mazes: rectangle (default), circle (round theta maze) or hexagon. Example: circle

size.description: Grid size for all mazes instead of a difficulty: "columns x rows" (rectangle, hexagon) or rings (circle). Example: "12x16"

title.description: Title printed at the top of each page. Example: Space Explorer Mazes

name: generate_mazes
title: Generate printable mazes
